quest.title: NCPD Dispatch
quest.description: NCPD is short-handed and paying runners to help with crimes in progress. Get to the scene, deal with the suspects and keep the civilians alive.

templates.text: NCPD is looking for a runner to assist. Armed robbery in progress, suspects are {Gang}, civilians on scene. Paying on completion. Interested?
NCPD is looking for a runner to assist. A {Gang} crew is working someone over and our units are tied up. Paying on completion. Interested?
NCPD is looking for a runner to assist. Shots fired, multiple {Gang} suspects, expect resistance. Hazard pay on completion. Interested?
NCPD needs a runner, fast. {Gang} and a rival crew are shooting it out in the street and you're the closest. Big payout if you shut it down. Interested?

messages.text: NCPD Dispatch to V. Line check, we read you.
Noted, V. You're on our contractor list. We'll ping you when something comes up.
Tried your line, V. We'll call back shortly.
Good. Location's on your map. Get there before it gets worse.
No answer, V. We gave it to someone else.
Heads up! They called in a hitter. Watch yourself.
Scene's clear, good work. Payment's in your account.
Scene's clear and every suspect taken alive. The precinct noticed. Bonus transferred.
Paramedics say the civilians made it. That's worth something to us, V. Bonus added.
Scene's clear, but some of them got away. Half pay.
Disregard, V. We can't get you to that scene. Our units are taking it.
Disregard, our units got there first. We pay for speed, V.
You walked off an active scene. We'll remember that next time we're hiring.
You're on our regular contractor list now, V. Heavier jobs are coming your way.
Trusted contractor. We'll send NCPD units to back you on the big jobs now.
Preferred contractor. Not bad for a merc nobody vouched for. Keep it up.
The precinct wants you on call, V. You're the first runner we ring now.
